/**
 * Responsibility: provide the legacy core board-data exit for existing callers.
 * Input/output: contract-owned configuration shapes and identical policy arrays.
 * This facade owns no composition verdict, defaults application, state or rules;
 * consumers migrate to the public contract before its C44 removal.
 */
export {
  EVENT_PACK_IDS,
  ELIMINATION_PRIORITIES,
  SHERIFF_ELECTION_POLICIES,
  EXILE_VOTE_POLICIES,
  SHERIFF_BADGE_POLICIES,
  WITCH_KNIFE_VISIBILITY_POLICIES,
  WITCH_POTION_POLICIES,
  GUARD_REPEAT_POLICIES,
  HIDDEN_WOLF_CAMP_INSPECTION_POLICIES,
  SEER_TARGET_POLICIES,
  SEER_ACTION_POLICIES,
  DEFAULT_SEER_ACTION_POLICY,
  DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES,
  WOLF_KING_DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES,
  INSPECTION_POLICIES,
  DEATH_REVEAL_POLICIES,
  LAST_WORDS_POLICIES,
  DREAM_PROTECTION_POLICIES,
  BEAUTY_DEATH_LINK_POLICIES,
  CUPID_POLICIES,

} from "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-contract";
export type {
  EliminationPriority,
  HookConfig,
  SelfDestructConfig,
  SheriffElectionPolicy,
  ExileVotePolicy,
  SheriffBadgePolicy,
  SheriffConfig,
  WitchKnifeVisibilityPolicy,
  WitchPotionPolicy,
  WitchConfig,
  TieBreakerConfig,
  GuardRepeatPolicy,
  HiddenWolfCampInspectionPolicy,
  SeerTargetPolicy,
  SeerActionPolicy,
  HunterDeathActionPolicy,
  DeathActionPolicy,
  InspectionPolicy,
  DeathRevealPolicy,
  LastWordsPolicy,
  DreamProtectionPolicy,
  BeautyDeathLinkPolicy,
  CupidPolicy,
  DebaterPolicy,
  BoardConfig,
} from "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-contract";

/**
 * Responsibility: preserve the existing core board-schema entry for callers.
 * Input/output: the contract-owned strict inert board shape and identical schema.
 * Configuration I/O, default merging, composition support and runtime state are
 * outside this compatibility facade; consumers migrate before C44 removal.
 * It never reads configuration files, applies defaults or executes rules.
 */
export { boardConfigSchema } from "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-contract";

/**
 * Owns the existing ordered identifiers for the eleven domain component slots.
 * Inputs are the established ECS names; output is the unchanged runtime object
 * and closed ComponentName union consumed by World and the typed component map.
 * This registry never creates components, validates values or writes World state.
 */
export const COMPONENT = {
  Identity: "IdentityComponent",
  Role: "RoleComponent",
  Camp: "CampComponent",
  Alive: "AliveComponent",
  VotingRight: "VotingRightComponent",
  StatusMarks: "StatusMarksComponent",
  Badge: "BadgeComponent",
  Victory: "VictoryComponent",
  Lovers: "LoversComponent",
  WallNote: "WallNoteComponent",
  DebatePenalty: "DebatePenaltyComponent",
} as const;

/**
 * ECS 组件名联合类型。
 */
export type ComponentName = (typeof COMPONENT)[keyof typeof COMPONENT];

/**
 * Provides the named compatibility exit for core result and summary consumers.
 * Inputs come from game-contract's sole data owner; outputs preserve existing
 * public imports and types. This bridge performs no rule calculation, rendering
 * or additional state write and must disappear after its consumers migrate.
 */
export type {
  GameResult,
  WinDecision,
  SeerCheckResult,
  NightSummary,
  DaySummary,
  VotingSummary,
  RuntimeSnapshot,
} from "@ai-werewolf-arena/game-contract";

/**
 * Responsibility: validate the inert serialized shape of a board configuration.
 * Input: unknown data; output: the original strict Zod BoardConfig schema result.
 * It preserves optional fields, integer bounds and the 55-member runtime Role
 * enum without applying defaults. Shape acceptance does not authorize a finite
 * combination or execute rules; rulesets separately own supported compositions.
 */
import { z } from "zod";
import {
  CAT_SKIPPED_VOTE_POLICIES,
  PUFFER_BALLOT_POLICIES,
  BEAR_SIGNAL_POLICIES,
} from "./board-policy-identifiers";
import {
  EVENT_PACK_IDS,
  CUPID_POLICIES,
  DEBATER_POLICIES,
  DREAM_PROTECTION_POLICIES,
  BEAUTY_DEATH_LINK_POLICIES,
  DEATH_REVEAL_POLICIES,
  LAST_WORDS_POLICIES,
  DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES,
  WOLF_KING_DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES,
  INSPECTION_POLICIES,
  GUARD_REPEAT_POLICIES,
  HIDDEN_WOLF_CAMP_INSPECTION_POLICIES,
  SEER_TARGET_POLICIES,
  SEER_ACTION_POLICIES,
  WITCH_KNIFE_VISIBILITY_POLICIES,
  WITCH_POTION_POLICIES,
  SHERIFF_ELECTION_POLICIES,
  SHERIFF_BADGE_POLICIES,
  EXILE_VOTE_POLICIES,
} from "./boards";
import { ActionWindow, KnightDuelWindow, Role, WinCondition, WitchSelfHealRule } from "./identity";

const positive = z.number().int().positive().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
const nonnegative = z.number().int().nonnegative().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
const strategies = z.enum(["min_id", "min_seat", "no_elimination", "no_kill"]);

/** Internal board shape shared by reverse configuration writing and reproduction. No defaults are added here. */
export const boardConfigSchema = z.strictObject({
  animalDream: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_animal_dream_v1"),
      eliminationPriority: z.literal("awa_wolf_priority_v1"),
    })
    .optional(),
  whiteCat: z.strictObject({ skippedVotePolicy: z.enum(CAT_SKIPPED_VOTE_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  pufferfish: z.strictObject({ ballotPolicy: z.enum(PUFFER_BALLOT_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  bear: z.strictObject({ signalPolicy: z.enum(BEAR_SIGNAL_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  fragrantPairSeer: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_fragrant_pair_seer_v1") }).optional(),
  nobleSecretBody: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_noble_secret_body_v1") }).optional(),
  nightNoble: z
    .strictObject({ wolfActionPolicy: z.enum(["standard", "no_blast_no_self_knife"]) })
    .optional(),
  awakenedIdiot: z
    .strictObject({
      protectionRepeatPolicy: z.enum(["awa_nonconsecutive_nights_v1", "awa_repeat_v1"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  radiantEclipse: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_radiant_eclipse_v1") }).optional(),
  mistRaven: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_mist_raven_v1") }).optional(),
  scholarMentor: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_scholar_mentor_twelve_v1") }).optional(),
  timeConsort: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_time_consort_reflection_v1"),
      reflectionScope: z.enum(["whole_night", "first_effect"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  wolfSorcerer: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_wolf_sorcerer_seats_v1"),
      firstNight: z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2)]),
    })
    .optional(),
  trickster: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_trickster_exile_v1") }).optional(),
  orderPrince: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_order_prince_first_ballot_v1") }).optional(),
  magician: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_magician_wolf_king_v1"),
      firstNight: z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2)]),
      deathShotTargetPolicy: z.enum(["original", "exchanged"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  redMoon: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_red_moon_demon_v1"),
      lastWolfBlastPolicy: z.enum(["ends_game", "forbidden"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  nightmareShadow: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_nightmare_dreamer_v1"),
      fearActionPolicy: z.enum(["optional", "required_when_legal"]),
      wolfActionPolicy: z.enum(["standard", "no_blast_no_self_knife"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  evilKnight: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_evil_knight_v1"),
      shotPolicy: z.enum(["night_shot_immune", "hunter_shot_bypasses"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  pureWhite: z
    .strictObject({
      policy: z.literal("awa_pure_white_night_v1"),
      eliminationPriority: z.enum(["awa_good_priority_v1", "awa_wolf_priority_v1"]),
    })
    .optional(),
  wolfWitch: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_pure_white_night_v1") }).optional(),
  demonHunter: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_netease_demon_hunter_v1") }).optional(),
  ghostBride: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_melbourne_ghost_bride_v1") }).optional(),
  events: z.strictObject({ pack: z.enum(EVENT_PACK_IDS) }).optional(),
  lonelyGirl: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_netease_lonely_girl_v1") }).optional(),
  wildChild: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_lui_meme_wild_child_v1") }).optional(),
  shapeshifter: z
    .strictObject({ policy: z.literal("awa_netease_shapeshifter_two_extra_villagers_v1") })
    .optional(),
  thief: z.strictObject({ policy: z.literal("lui_meme_thief_two_extra_villagers_v1") }).optional(),
  debater: z.strictObject({ policy: z.enum(DEBATER_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  cupid: z.strictObject({ policy: z.enum(CUPID_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  dreamer: z.strictObject({ protectionPolicy: z.enum(DREAM_PROTECTION_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  wolfBeauty: z.strictObject({ deathLinkPolicy: z.enum(BEAUTY_DEATH_LINK_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  disclosure: z.strictObject({ deathRevealPolicy: z.enum(DEATH_REVEAL_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  lastWords: z.strictObject({ policy: z.enum(LAST_WORDS_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  boardSize: positive.max(128),
  enableSheriff: z.boolean(),
  initialSheriffSeat: positive.optional(),
  winConditions: z.array(z.enum(WinCondition)).optional(),
  winCondition: z.enum(WinCondition).optional(),
  hooks: z.strictObject({
    onDaybreak: z.boolean(),
    onPreElection: z.boolean(),
    onPreVote: z.boolean(),
    onPerSpeechGap: z.boolean(),
  }),
  roleSetups: z.array(z.strictObject({ role: z.enum(Role), count: nonnegative.max(128) })).min(1),
  selfDestruct: z.strictObject({ enabledWindows: z.array(z.enum(ActionWindow)) }).optional(),
  sheriff: z
    .strictObject({
      voteWeight: z.number().finite().positive().optional(),
      electionPolicy: z.enum(SHERIFF_ELECTION_POLICIES).optional(),
      badgePolicy: z.enum(SHERIFF_BADGE_POLICIES).optional(),
    })
    .optional(),
  voting: z.strictObject({ exilePolicy: z.enum(EXILE_VOTE_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  knight: z.strictObject({ enabledWindows: z.array(z.enum(KnightDuelWindow)) }).optional(),
  hunter: z.strictObject({ deathActionPolicy: z.enum(DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  wolfKing: z
    .strictObject({ deathActionPolicy: z.enum(WOLF_KING_DEATH_ACTION_POLICIES) })
    .optional(),
  gargoyle: z.strictObject({ inspectionPolicy: z.enum(INSPECTION_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  psychic: z.strictObject({ inspectionPolicy: z.enum(INSPECTION_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  mirrorGirl: z.strictObject({ inspectionPolicy: z.enum(INSPECTION_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  guard: z.strictObject({ repeatPolicy: z.enum(GUARD_REPEAT_POLICIES) }).optional(),
  hiddenWolf: z
    .strictObject({ campInspection: z.enum(HIDDEN_WOLF_CAMP_INSPECTION_POLICIES) })
    .optional(),
  seer: z
    .strictObject({
      targetPolicy: z.enum(SEER_TARGET_POLICIES),
      actionPolicy: z.enum(SEER_ACTION_POLICIES),
    })
    .optional(),
  witch: z
    .strictObject({
      canSelfHeal: z.enum(WitchSelfHealRule).optional(),
      knifeVisibility: z.enum(WITCH_KNIFE_VISIBILITY_POLICIES).optional(),
      potionPolicy: z.enum(WITCH_POTION_POLICIES).optional(),
    })
    .optional(),
  tieBreaker: z
    .strictObject({
      exileVote: strategies.optional(),
      wolfKillVote: strategies.optional(),
      sheriffVote: strategies.optional(),
    })
    .optional(),
});

}
